questions.text: Describe Ashoka's administration.
questions.text_as_printed: Describe Ashoka's administration. (A)

answer.value:
The Mauryan Empire had a centralized administrative system:
Power was centralized in the king
An administrative class of officials existed
Strong espionage system
The empire was divided into provinces and princes were appointed as governors
Under the king were ministers, priests, commander-in-chief, and princes
Taxila, Ujjain, Tosali, Suvarnagiri, and Girnar were administrative centers
There were officials called Rajukas and Yuktas
Pataliputra was the capital, and there were six committees

questions.text: Write a note on Kanishka's administration.
questions.text_as_printed: Write a note on Kanishka's administration. (A)

answer.value:
During Kanishka's reign, the Kushan Empire expanded greatly:
He began the Saka Era in 78 CE
Purushapura was his capital; another city was Mathura
Buddhism flourished greatly
Ashvaghosha, Vasumitra, and Sangharaksha were scholars
The Fourth Buddhist Council was held in Kashmir under his leadership
Like Ashoka, he sent missions to Central Asia and China to spread Buddhism
He gave great encouragement to art and architecture
